best_for: Photographers, designers and hobbyists who need a free image editor for retouching and compositing and do not want an Adobe subscription.

points.title: Free software, no subscription
points.text: GIMP is GPL software made by a volunteer community. There is no account, no paid tier and nothing to renew.

points.title: Edit, compose, script
points.text: It covers photo retouching, compositing, icons and mockups. Edits can be automated in C, C++, Python or Scheme, and third-party plugins add more.

points.title: Windows 10 1903 or newer
points.text: The installer needs Windows 10 version 1903 or later. The Microsoft Store edition needs Windows 11 or build 20348, a change made to avoid a data loss bug.

points.title: Not in the Mac App Store
points.text: The GIMP team does not publish to Apple's App Store, so copies there come from third parties. The official Mac images need macOS 11 Big Sur and come for Intel and Apple silicon.

points.title: Linux comes from gimp.org
points.text: This site lists Windows and macOS only. Linux users can get the Flatpak, a Snap, or an AppImage, which needs Debian 13 or a newer distribution.

points.title: A short history here
points.text: The Windows installer comes in per-user and machine-wide forms, x64 only here, though the project also builds for Arm64. Windows keeps 2 versions and macOS only the current release, so older builds need another source.
